build_transition_block: build a TransitionBlock Haiku module with GLU kernel for transformer transition layers
build_msa_attention: build an MSAAttention module with configurable num_head for multiple sequence alignment attention
build_grid_self_attention: build a GridSelfAttention module for per-sequence or per-residue self-attention with flash attention
build_triangle_multiplication: build a TriangleMultiplication module with incoming or outgoing equation for pairwise feature propagation
build_evoformer_iteration: build an EvoformerIteration module combining MSA attention, outer product mean, and pair attention blocks
